proxy: Cell contact and hematopoietic lineage co-vary with GJA1. Dvir et al. reported blood-lineage enrichment. A direct Cx43 intervention is needed to isolate channel-specific rescue.

evidence: Rosenski et al. previously listed PUDP as the top expression feature for predicting ITPA dependency (unsigned importance 0.16071, Additional file 1, Table 3). The 25Q3 DepMap ITPA model already lists PUDP expression as its strongest predictive feature (34.5% importance), followed by STS expression (6.7%). No primary paper demonstrating that relationship was located in the searches. Shi et al. lack this pair in their published coefficient tables. In the 24Q2 public model table, MIR4767 DNA copy number ranked first and PUDP RNA second. The table reports unsigned feature importance. The regional DNA association also has prior art.
proxy: Regional deletion is a credible alternative. Xie et al. demonstrated contiguous PUDP/STS/VCX/PNPLA4 loss in constitutional Xp22.31 deletions. The DepMap model also nominates STS. These observations do not establish that STS, another passenger, or a constitutional deletion caused the cancer-line signal. MIR4767 lies within the genomic interval annotated for PUDP. Four of six deep-loss donors in the present test also lost STS.
